events.headline: Caleb Williams carted off with a non-contact hamstring injury in the fourth quarter of the Bears' 9-3 loss to Minnesota
events.detail: Williams pulled up scrambling on first-and-goal with Chicago trailing 6-3 and could not put weight on his right leg. He was helped off, carted to the locker room and ruled out for the rest of the game after going 15 of 26 for 138 yards with an interception and 42 rushing yards on five carries. Tyson Bagent replaced him and was sacked on fourth-and-2 from the 12 to end the game. Ben Johnson said only "We'll see how bad it is tomorrow." Week 3 is at home against Philadelphia.
events.so_what: Nothing is known yet, so this is a real question for Week 3 and not a diagnosis. A hamstring costs a mobile quarterback more than a pocket passer, because rushing yards under the konami premium are a real part of his weekly line. Bagent is a bench name at best behind a scoring-starved offense.
